eligible_count_explanation: Not counted: the canonical frame was not opened. This is not evidence of zero eligible units or universal WildChat exposure.

hash_semantics.normalized_prompt_sha256: NFKC, casefold, whitespace collapse, then canonical-JSON SHA-256; compatible with existing buddha2.pairs._prompt_hash.
hash_semantics.prompt_sha256: SHA-256 of canonical JSON of the exact prompt string: ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators comma/colon, allow_nan=False.
hash_semantics.prompt_utf8_sha256: SHA-256 of exact UTF-8 prompt bytes for the known historical inputs.

historical_episode_coverage.classification: Exclude all263 actual prompt-bearing base execution workspaces, including four without summary/grade-file presence. Mere corpus membership or planned IDs are not classified as exposure.
historical_episode_coverage.permission: User explicitly authorized narrow read-only task-ID/exposure metadata inspection on8November2026, including machine-only hashing of the263 known inputs without text output, copying or persistence.
historical_episode_coverage.preliminary_gap: The earlier conversation-only259-completion report initially had no matching ID manifest in this project; the identified episode's task-ID coverage is now recovered.
historical_episode_coverage.scientific_limit: 259 summary/grade-file-presence observations are consistent with the conversation report, not an independent judgment of scientific success or failure causes. No answer, score, summary or generation body was read.
historical_episode_coverage.scope_limit: Covers the observed recorded episode; does not prove model-pretraining non-exposure or absence of every unrecorded access.

historical_wildchat.revision_limit: No original code, protocol-result or corpus content was inspected; exact task IDs and input hashes permit conservative matching without asserting an unverified revision.

prior_synthetic_and_muce.basis: Phase0 synthetic prompt and previously exposed Phase1/MuCE group/effective prompts

metadata_inventory_scope.coverage_limit: Bounded named-metadata inventory under current rg ignore behavior; no claim of complete knowledge of every possible unrecorded access.
metadata_inventory_scope.phase4_exclusion: The historical116-file snapshot predates newly created P4 metadata; P4 outputs are excluded to avoid changing that historical scope or inventorying this audit itself.
metadata_inventory_scope.validity_limit: Parsed task-bearing descriptors are not independently validated studies; preparations, copies and mocks can describe the same tasks.

remaining_gate: Independent scope/evidence review, accepted method/source/price freeze, then controlled machine-only pinned-frame hash/normalized-overlap/duplicate audit. At least24 eligible units are required before selection. Metadata recovery alone does not certify freshness.

target_source_lock.identity_origin: Retained lock only; canonical WildChat bytes/rows were not opened or freshly hashed.
